paragraph1: The Flavor House is where Trinidad kitchens meet a downtown Dayton corner. Scotch bonnet, green seasoning, and slow-stewed oxtail, woven through with Creole and soul-food tradition, and served in a room designed for a slow evening and a good crowd.
paragraph2: Come for a lunch plate. Stay for a craft cocktail and real hospitality. Warm pendant light, low music, and a unique dining experience with flavorful, from-scratch food and superior service.

pillars.title: Caribbean & Creole
pillars.body: Cooked from scratch. Gumbo, oxtail, rum-glazed salmon, curry roti, and Signature baked mac. No shortcuts.

pillars.title: Cocktail Culture
pillars.body: A full bar of house cocktails and top-shelf spirits. Happy Hour every day, 4 to 6PM, half off the good stuff.

pillars.title: Cigars & Celebrations
pillars.body: A cigar patio and a connected private room built for showers, mixers, and the whole family.
